verdict.rationale: Base44 documents its own GitHub connection for version control, and says the backend, including agent behavior, permissions, and tools, is defined in code and local JSONC config files, so agent automations can be versioned alongside app code. Review and rollback of automations are not documented, and nothing shows that Superagent workflows (scheduled or triggered) live in versioned code. missing for 10: documented versioning of Superagent workflows, a built-in review/approval step for automation changes, a documented rollback mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Connect your Base44 app to GitHub for version control, local development, and collaboration.
Define agent behavior, permissions, and tools using local JSONC configuration files.
Your entire backend is defined in code and configuration files
